title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: This committee ensures Indian badminton players have a formal voice in the sport's administration and decision-making processes.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) officially announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a structured platform for player representation within the national federation.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway for BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: India's top junior talent is currently training intensively at the NCE Guwahati to prepare for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo, Egypt.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Centre of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, bringing together India's promising young shuttlers for rigorous training.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course enhances the expertise of Indian coaches, which is crucial for developing future badminton talent across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, aiming to upgrade coaching standards.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships at NCE Guwahati
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttlers are undergoing a specialized coaching camp to hone their skills for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting the Indian team coaching camp for players selected to represent the nation at the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly impact how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
